profile_headline: Designing Data intensive applications at KarmaLifeAI
post_content:
I won't do Image analysis in night time ever. I was working on an emotion
identifier by facial expression this weekend, finally got it working by 11 pm,
I was extremely happy and was testing it by making weird faces, suddenly
noticed my webcam is drawing some red coloured face bounding block behind me
with emotion indicating as "angry"(though there was no face shown in the box).
Somehow I gathered courage and turned to check ,still there was nothing but my
webcam was still showing the red bounding block there. It was too creepy to
continue, I closed it and now listening songs to distract myself . Hope will
sleep soon :) P.S. : It is just the case of false positives
(https://lnkd.in/f_VG_JY and https://lnkd.in/fstsPAH)
